name: ALGEBRAIC_DECOUPLING_VIA_ASYMMETRIC_NODE_FUNCTIONS
description: Replaces the homogeneous edge constraint from the seed with two asymmetric diagnostic functions $V_u$ and $V_w$ that depend directly on the node labels $u$ and $w$. Their sum mathematically simplifies to $(u+w)(x-y)^2$, which equals 0 if and only if $x=y$. This defeats degree-ordered backtracking by making the constraint appear to be a complex, node-pair-dependent relationship rather than a simple equivalence relation, successfully disrupting the model's pattern matching to ordinary graph 3-coloring.
